//: Tasks run as type:process through .vscode/dev-run.cmd, which enters the VS x64 Developer
environment (cl/ninja) and then runs the given cmake command verbatim. This works regardless
of how VS Code was launched. (Interactive terminals get the same env via the VS Dev PowerShell
Use these instead of the CMake sidebar's Build/Install buttons. CMake Tools substitutes its own
selected target into every build step of a workflow preset, so 'Workflow -> Install' silently
builds only the status-bar target and installs nothing. See .vscode/OneMill-Setup-Ledger.md.
NEVER add a bare '--parallel' to these commands. CMake only consults CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL
(set to cores-2 by dev-run.cmd) when --parallel is absent; a bare --parallel makes Ninja
oversubscribe at cores+2 and freeze the machine.
The presets referenced here live in CMakeUserPresets.json, which is gitignored. Copy
CMakeUserPresets.json.example and adjust the machine paths first, or these tasks will not resolve.
